# BBC

> > The British Broadcasting Corporation's comprehensive news, sports, and entertainment platform covering the UK and international stories.

BBC.co.uk serves as the UK's public service broadcaster, delivering breaking news, live sports coverage including football and cricket, and extensive regional reporting across England, Scotland, and Wales. The platform provides hyperlocal news feeds for hundreds of UK communities alongside national and international coverage.

## Key Topics

- BBC Sport
- England Football
- Cricket (Ashes, Test, T20, ODI)
- Scottish Highlands & Islands
- Wales regional news
- UK local news
- Regional weather updates
- Community news feeds
- Liverpool FC
- Wiltshire
- RAF bases
- UK regional updates
- Crufts
- CalMac ferries
- The Hundred cricket

## Sports Coverage

- [England Men's Football Team - BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/teams/england): England Men's Football: news, fixtures, Tuchel updates, World Cup 2026
- [Liverpool FC - Transfer news, results, fixtures, video and audio](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/teams/liverpool): Liverpool FC: transfers, fixtures, results, Champions League updates
- [Cricket – Ashes, Test, T20 & ODI news, scores & results – BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket): Cricket hub: Ashes, Test, T20, ODI news, scores, The Hundred updates
